eventDetail.scope: The 2nd IEEE International Conference on Smart Innovations in Systems, Infrastructure, Mechanical, Power, AI and Computing Technologies (SISIMPACT 2027) provides an international platform for researchers, academicians, industry experts, and students to share advancements in intelligent and sustainable technologies. The conference covers smart systems, artificial intelligence, machine learning, computing, communication networks, industrial automation, robotics, signal processing, power electronics, renewable energy, smart grids, electric vehicles, IoT, cyber-physical systems, and smart infrastructure. It promotes interdisciplinary research, industry-academia collaboration, innovation, and practical solutions for addressing emerging technological, industrial, and societal challenges.
